# `as_jsf_result()`

Convert a JSF output data frame to a JSFResult object

## Usage

```r
as_jsf_result(
  x,
  method = "operator-splitting",
  config = list(),
  species_names = NULL
)
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | Data frame returned by `jsf_simulate()` or a model-specific wrapper. It must contain a `time` column. |
| `method` | JSF simulation method used. |
| `config` | List of simulation configuration values. |
| `species_names` | Optional character vector of species columns to include. |

## Value

A `JSFResult` object.

## Examples

```r
df <- data.frame(
  time = c(0, 0.1, 0.2),
  S = c(990, 988, 985),
  I = c(10, 12, 15),
  R = c(0, 0, 0)
)

result <- as_jsf_result(
  df,
  config = list(model = "SIR", dt = 0.1)
)

result
summary(result)
```
